## What changed

Describe the behavior and why it belongs in this change.

## Verification

- [ ] Regression tests added or updated where practical
- [ ] `make lint`
- [ ] `go test ./...`
- [ ] `cd web && npm run build` when web code changed
- [ ] Documentation updated for flags, API/schema, or deployment changes
- [ ] No secrets, generated snapshots, GeoLite databases, screenshots, or binaries included

## Security and compatibility

Call out trust-boundary changes, peer-controlled inputs, schema migrations, and client
interoperability implications. Link private security reports only after disclosure.
